name: Backdown (Combat)
body:
The threat of being hit again causes your enemy to flinch.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +4, Intimidate 5 ranks.

Benefit: After a successful Power Attack against a melee target, they must make a Will Save DC 10 + 1/2 of your character level + Strength modifier. If they fail the saving throw, they are flat-footed for 1 round. Back down is a mind-affecting fear effect.
